definitions.gloss: drowsiness; sleepiness; the irresistible urge to sleep
definitions.explanation: An overwhelming feeling of drowsiness that is difficult to fight. Literally the "sleep demon" — personifying sleepiness as a force that attacks.

examples.japanese: {睡魔|すいま}に{襲|おそ}われた。
{午後|ごご}の{会議中|かいぎちゅう}に{睡魔|すいま}と{闘|たたか}った。
examples.english: I fought off drowsiness during the afternoon meeting.

examples.japanese: {昼食後|ちゅうしょくご}はいつも{睡魔|すいま}に{襲|おそ}われるので、コーヒーを{飲|の}むようにしている。
examples.english: I always get drowsy after lunch, so I make sure to drink coffee.

notes:
{睡魔|すいま} literally means "sleep demon" ({睡|すい} = sleep + {魔|ま} = demon). It personifies drowsiness as an external force that attacks a person, similar to the English expression "the sandman."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {睡魔|すいま}に{襲|おそ}われる (to be overcome by drowsiness)
- {睡魔|すいま}と{闘|たたか}う (to fight off drowsiness)
- {睡魔|すいま}に{負|ま}ける (to give in to drowsiness)
- {睡魔|すいま}が{襲|おそ}う (drowsiness attacks)

USAGE NOTES:
This word is commonly used in everyday conversation, often with a touch of humor. The most frequent pattern is {睡魔|すいま}に{襲|おそ}われる — being "attacked" by the sleep demon. It vividly expresses the feeling of struggling against overwhelming sleepiness, especially during work or study.
